title: Finance-Informed Operator Learning for Option Pricing with Quantum-Compatible Realizations
summary: Pricing European options under local volatility requires repeatedly solving a PDE whose coefficients change with recalibration, while practitioners need both prices and sensitivities across spot-time surfaces. Neural surrogates can amortize these solves, but near expiry the solution loses regularity, making curvature difficult to learn and allowing violations of no-arbitrage bounds. We propose a finance-informed Deep Operator Network (FI-DeepONet) that decomposes the pricing operator into an input-dependent Black-Scholes carrier and a learned correction.
